However, rising oil prices are intensifying inflation concerns and strengthening expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike. The better-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report also revived bets for a September interest rate hike by the US Federal Reserve (Fed) amid inflation risks stemming from persistently higher energy prices. Investors are also awaiting key US inflation data this week, which could provide further clues on the Federal Reserves policy outlook ahead of next weeks meeting.
